column1: # ESP32 OTA-capable partition table for 4 MB flash
# Measured firmware.bin at time of addition: ~886 KB (906432 bytes)
# Each app slot is 1536 KB (~1.7x current firmware) to leave growth room.
# Layout: nvs 20K + otadata 8K + app0 1536K + app1 1536K + spiffs 960K
#   otadata  0x00E000 – 0x00FFFF  ( 8 KB)  — PlatformIO writes boot_app0.bin here
#   app0     0x010000 – 0x18FFFF  (1536 KB) — PlatformIO serial upload writes firmware here
#   Devices currently running the default single-app partition table must be
#   serial-flashed once with this new partition table before browser OTA
